evidence: Commercial Cp2ZrCl2 (Strem Chemicals, #93-4002, 99%) was used as the zirconium precursor without purification while Y(thd)3 was synthesised according to Eisentraut and Sievers. O3 was used as oxidiser and it was generated from O2 (99.999%) in an ozone generator (Fischer model 502). Nitrogen (>99.999%, Schmidlin UHPN 3000 N2 generator) was used as carrier and purging gas.
